notablePrerequisites:
Towashi Guide-Bot does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four modified creatures.
description:
Activate Towashi Guide-Bot by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creture token with flying and haste.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
